title: Mosaic: Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.22174v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Most existing agentic reinforcement learning methods assume single-session trajectories, where interaction proceeds within one continuously accumulated context. However, agentic techniques such as context compaction and subagent forking may produce trajectories spanning multiple sessions, creating a mismatch between the single-session training assumption and inference-time execution. Therefore, we introduce Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning, a more general setting that supports an arbitrary number of sessions within a trajectory. Under this setting, a widely adopted method is to broadcast trajectory-level advantages to all sessions, but this does not distinguish contributions from various sessions or guide session allocation within trajectories. To address this issue, we propose Mosaic, a multi-session agentic RL method with critic-free hierarchical optimization. At the trajectory level, it incorporates session-usage signals

translated_title: Mosaic：多会话智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 现有的大多数智能体强化学习方法都假设轨迹是单会话的，即交互在单一连续累积的上下文中进行。然而，上下文压缩和子智能体分叉等智能体技术可能产生跨越多个会话的轨迹，这导致单会话训练假设与推理时实际执行之间存在不匹配。因此，我们提出了多会话智能体强化学习，这是一个更通用的设定，支持一条轨迹中包含任意数量的会话。在该设定下，一种被广泛采用的方法是将轨迹级优势广播到所有会话，但这无法区分各个会话的不同贡献，也无法指导轨迹内会话的分配。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 Mosaic，一种采用无评论员（critic-free）层次化优化的多会话智能体强化学习方法。在轨迹层面，它引入了会话使用信号（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 Mosaic 方法，通过无评论员的层次化优化机制区分多会话智能体强化学习中各会话的不同贡献，弥合单会话训练假设与多会话推理执行之间的不匹配。
en_tdlr: Mosaic introduces a critic-free hierarchical optimization method for multi-session agentic reinforcement learning, which distinguishes the contributions of different sessions within a trajectory and resolves the mismatch between single-session training assumptions and multi-session inference execution.
